summary: Phase 1C CORS/cookie-session verification executed on both internal localhost and external preview. Internal backend CORS+cookie contract passes for trusted origin; external preview edge still returns wildcard ACAO and omits ACAC for credentialed auth, which is the first blocker for cross-origin cookie session reliability.

critical.issue: External effective CORS contract failed: Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' instead of exact frontend origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials missing/empty for credentialed cross-origin auth.
Untrusted origin probe still receives Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' on edge response, violating deny expectation for credentialed auth routes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Internal checks (http://localhost:8001) pass for trusted origin CORS and cookie attributes. External preview checks reproducibly fail CORS contract with ACAO='*' and missing ACAC on /api/auth/login OPTIONS+POST; untrusted external origin also receives '*'. Authorization regression suites passed (20/20). Frontend build passed via yarn build. Browser automation on frontend host was blocked by preview wrapper state indicating wake-up/embedding layer interference.
rca of the issue: Root cause is most likely external edge/proxy CORS rewriting/normalization overriding backend credentialed headers. Reproduction: send Origin=https://financial-ssot.preview.emergentagent.com to external /api/auth/login (OPTIONS or POST). Observed effective headers: ACAO='*' and no ACAC; expected exact origin + ACAC=true for credentials. Internal localhost does return expected headers, isolating issue away from core FastAPI auth logic. Cookie attributes on successful login are present (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=None, Path=/), but browser credentialed cross-origin policy remains blocked by external CORS contract mismatch.
